items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1968-03-03
items.q: I got a record of yours that was made in Hamburg with Jimmy Archie and Darnell Howard and the rest.

ctx.x: Glad to be here, too, man.
I got a record of yours that was made in Hamburg with Jimmy Archie and Darnell Howard and the rest. Have you made any since then?
Yeah, we made some records in England, too. We just got them here in America, and I think they were some of the greatest records we made.
